--- Page 1 (Beckerman_20a) --- Dear Jack, This week hasn't as yet brought your expected letter but it probably isn't far off. The past seven days have gone by following the usual pattern with Papa continuing to work... and this morning Mama getting up extra early to light the oven and within 2 hrs. bring forth an array of cakes that needed only some more mouths to enjoy them. Apples are in season now and besides enjoying them in pie form Papa is even now taking a hand in cutting them - but from a maternal design whose finished product will be something more in his line - a dress for Mama. The weather here is following right along with the calendar; which proclaims Spring and Spring it is! You can see it springing forth from the buds of every tree and mainly by the fact that dinner is usually late and supper cold because to go indoors seems a crime - especially since you had to chance frost bite to get a breath of air. --- Page 2 (Beckerman_20b) --- put to good use with the coming days of sunshine 'Kids' can be seen digging energetically within small fenced-in plots that they hope will emerge into fruit- ful Victory Gardens! Easter and Passover holidays are approaching and the one material way we know it is the 5 lb. bag of matzahs that is waiting to temporarily supplement the yearly rye.... We don't know whether the annual Seder will go on this year with all the trimmings; but for the first time we can actually look forward to the next, hoping that all the pre-war seats will be filled. - We're looking forward to hearing from you soon and until then Regards from all Mama, Papa, Ruth
